title: Tooltips
summary: Tooltips add brief context; they must not carry essential instructions.

MUST.text: Expose the tooltip on hover and keyboard focus; keep it dismissible (Esc) and available while pointer/focus remains (WCAG 1.4.13).
Do not obscure the trigger; position so content stays visible on hover/focus (WCAG 1.4.13).
Provide an accessible name for the trigger independent of the tooltip.

SHOULD.text: Use for short clarifications only (a sentence or less).
Delay show slightly to avoid flicker; persist while hovered or focused.

AVOID.text: Do not replace labels or put long help in hover-only content.
Do not show tooltips on touch-only targets without an alternative.

EXAMPLE.good: Tooltip supplements an accessible “Export CSV” button name; dismissible with Esc
EXAMPLE.bad: a field label exists only as a tooltip

FAILURE_MODES: Hover-only content is unreachable for keyboard and touch users.
Tooltips covering triggers cause flicker and loss of access (WCAG 1.4.13).
Essential instructions hidden in tooltips cause task failure.

sources.title: W3C WCAG 2.2 Understanding Content on Hover or Focus
